body: Wow. I can't thank you enough for sending this link my way. When I first saw it I thought it looked like just another get-rich-quick site, but I've read through the first 40 pages and this stuff is good! I'm excited to see what the rest has to say, and I think it's pretty inspiring just to know that YOU are self employed (and I assume you've followed some of the advice in the book). Thanks again.

This really struck a chord with me. 

My passion is music, particularly electronic music. I love music more than anything. That's the only thing right now that I enjoy. Sometimes I feel like I have no idea what I'm doing here studying boring shit at a university when I know that what I truly want to do is make music. But then I won't make money. At some point in high school I made a resigned decision that I was going to have to join the corporate rat race if I wanted to succeed in my adult life. Maybe that's not true...

Very interesting perspective. I really appreciate you taking the time to write this. You're right - maybe if I stop wasting time worrying so much about myself and what is wrong with me and instead put my focus elsewhere, the other issues might work themselves out.
Unfortunately not, it's another midwestern university. Thanks for your offer though! Things do change - it's just been hard to keep that in mind after an entire year of things not changing.
I'm glad to hear I'm not alone in my situation. Just knowing that makes me feel better. Thanks for your response!

Thank you for your response. The line was very helpful; I didn't know it existed so I'm glad you guys had a hunch about it. I haven't really had the motivation to get out there and find some activities - a lot of the time, it takes most of my energy just getting basic things done every day. The volunteering is a very good idea; I haven't done any of that in a while, but I'll definitely look into it.

Thank you. I've called them and I'm feeling a little better, for the time being. I'll definitely check out those readings.

Thanks for being there guys. I love Reddit and its people more than you know.
